hard_guards: Never invent price, discount, dependency, eligibility or savings.
Never treat current line-item spend as automatic removal savings.
Never calculate dollar savings from a benchmark alone.
Never mix company ACV with project-value evidence.
Unknown discount must not be silently carried into counterfactual pricing.
Every material financial claim must retain provenance.

engine_rules.Rule: Use user-entered current total and product-level prices.
Only consider products/capabilities that are not required and whose workflow can remain valid.
If user has a comparable alternative quote for the proposed configuration, calculate current minus alternative.
engine_rules.Allowed Result: VERIFIED or POTENTIAL depending on comparability
engine_rules.Never Do: Treat a line-item price as automatic savings.

engine_rules.Rule: Use normalized public/customer quotes only when ACV, product mix, term and commercial structure are sufficiently comparable.
engine_rules.Never Do: Turn a benchmark into a guaranteed price.

engine_rules.Rule: If evidence supports a bounded scenario but not an exact quote, show a range and assumptions.
If candidate is valid but alternative price is not defensible, calculate the maximum alternative price that achieves the user's target savings.
engine_rules.Never Do: Call the target an expected Procore price.

engine_rules.Rule: If no defensible counterfactual price exists, do not manufacture a dollar saving.
engine_rules.Output: Opportunity found but savings not quantifiable
engine_rules.Never Do: Use current line-item spend as savings.

engine_rules.Rule: If no valid optimization candidate is found, report that no defensible savings were identified.
engine_rules.Output: Current workflow appears reasonable based on available evidence
engine_rules.Never Do: Claim that savings are impossible in all circumstances.

engine_rules.Rule: Confidence reflects evidence quality and commercial comparability.

dependency_rules.Removal Guard: If inspections are required, do not recommend removing the commercial capability without validating impact.
Check active incident workflow before removal.
Check active observations workflow before removal.
Check whether forms are used for Q&S-critical processes.
Daily Log can remain part of PM workflows; do not assume removing Q&S removes all PM tools.
Flag integration and validate replacement before removal.

dependency_rules.User Confirmation Needed: NO unless customer workflow indicates one
dependency_rules.Removal Guard: Do not infer a module dependency merely because analytics consumes data.
Client contract, compliance, internal policy or required workflow blocks removal.

freemium_outputs.Free Result Content: Current spend + potential savings amount/range + main opportunity + confidence
freemium_outputs.Paid Unlock: Full configuration comparison, evidence chain, assumptions, negotiation strategy and detailed report

freemium_outputs.Free Result Content: Professional explanation that current configuration appears commercially reasonable based on available evidence
freemium_outputs.Paid Unlock: Detailed evidence review and scenario analysis

freemium_outputs.Free Scan Headline: Optimization opportunity identified — savings not yet quantifiable
freemium_outputs.Free Result Content: Candidate product/capability + current spend if known + reason + what must be confirmed
freemium_outputs.Paid Unlock: Detailed candidate analysis, evidence and negotiation plan
freemium_outputs.Savings Display Rule: Never equate current line-item spend with savings.

freemium_outputs.Free Result Content: Current vs actual alternative quote/outcome + verified annual difference
freemium_outputs.Paid Unlock: Detailed audit trail and evidence report
freemium_outputs.Savings Display Rule: Use VERIFIED only when comparable evidence supports it.

test_cases.Inputs / Scenario: Invoice Management: Not used; not required; no dependency; no alternative quote.
test_cases.Expected Brain Result: Optimization candidate; savings not yet quantifiable.
test_cases.Reason: Current line-item spend is not automatically removal savings.

test_cases.Inputs / Scenario: Same as T1 + comparable alternative quote is $131,200 vs current $147,596.
Q&S rarely used but client contract requires it.
test_cases.Expected Brain Result: Do not recommend removal; preserve workflow.

test_cases.Inputs / Scenario: Q&S not used; not required; comparable public evidence supports only a broad range.
test_cases.Reason: Comparable evidence supports bounded scenario, not exact price.

test_cases.Inputs / Scenario: User has $147,596 renewal and target is 10%; no alternative quote.
test_cases.Expected Brain Result: Maximum acceptable alternative price = $132,836.40; label as negotiation target.
test_cases.Reason: Target price is not a predicted Procore quote.

test_cases.Inputs / Scenario: No candidate products survive requirement/dependency checks.
Product line has technical integration with ERP/accounting.
test_cases.Expected Brain Result: Flag integration; ask replacement/dependency question before candidate removal.
test_cases.Reason: Integration does not prove commercial dependency, but removal risk exists.

test_cases.Inputs / Scenario: Current discount unknown; no quote-level discount evidence.
test_cases.Expected Brain Result: Continue with uncertainty; do not assume discount carries to alternative.
test_cases.Savings Claim?: Only if alternative evidence supports it
test_cases.Reason: Discount is account-specific and can change counterfactual economics.
